variants.headline: Shipbuilding for the colony route
variants.sub: Shipbuilding by the home world has provided a larger vessel or another vessel for the colony route.
variants.body:
The home world has built a larger ship or an additional ship for the colony route. The construction is a transport development, not an announcement of arrival. In assessing {target}, readers should distinguish provision of a vessel from an unreported schedule, cargo or immediate change in supplies.

A larger vessel or an additional vessel should not be confused with an established volume of delivered freight. Commercial planning requires the distinction between physical provision and actual service. Managers should avoid converting this shipbuilding report into a precise change in supply, cost or delivery dates without the necessary particulars.

We welcome {target} in this assessment. Construction for the route deserves recognition as a tangible development, even while a fair account keeps that achievement distinct from promises about voyages not established here. Reliable assessment begins with particulars rather than a politically convenient assumption.
